description: This file contains utility functions for converting OpenAI chat tools and tool choices into Anthropic's format, including handling different tool types and options for parallel calls.

methods.name: convertOpenAIToolToAnthropic
methods.description: Converts an OpenAI ChatCompletionTool to Anthropic's Tool format, mapping name, description, and input schema.

methods.name: convertOpenAIToolsToAnthropic
methods.description: Converts an array of OpenAI ChatCompletionTools to an array of Anthropic Tool definitions.

methods.name: convertOpenAIToolChoiceToAnthropic
methods.description: Maps OpenAI's tool_choice parameter to Anthropic's format, handling 'none', 'auto', 'required', and function objects, with optional parallel call control.
